scope: Frozen local design only. No product implementation, actual user-flow acceptance, provider conformance, SDC QA verdict, readiness or lifecycle change.
summary: R1 identifies the real production Run entry and a satisfactory proposed007→008 split, removes the test-only-driver escape and keeps provider capability/publication/media claims bounded. Two remaining locally designable decisions prevent a complete production restart/completion path: consume/recover the existing remount-time autorun intent, and distinguish command completion from authoritative session/result state. Both corrections belong to the already proposed007 minimal client; neither needs a real provider selection or008 full UI implementation.

refs.symbolOrSection: §8.1 preserve autorun/run-again, production controller no new Run on reconnect/restart
mount-time autorun query reads and increments runRequest
per-instance activation latch and fresh activation key

findings.finding: R1 correctly assigns a real controller to the production Run path but does not define how the existing autorun intent is consumed or how a guided activation is recognized after page/component restart. Current page reads autorun=1 on every mount; RunControl servedRunRequest and hook inFlight/acceptedLatch are only in memory. A reload, reconnect/remount or platform401 login return to that URL can therefore request a fresh guided start/key/session. The commandId map and server duplicate-per-command CAS do not prevent a new session/Run identity. Merely saying no auto-new Run and preserving every existing autorun route does not resolve this source-backed conflict.
findings.impact: A single original Run/deep link can become another guided execution after restart, independently of lost-ACK deduplication within the first session. It also leaves the minimal007 reconnect call path dependent on implementer guesses or later008 work.
findings.requiredAction: Define one concrete guided-only intent consumption/recovery mechanism in the same reserved page/RunControl/useRunGate/client paths before the first asynchronous start. State what nonsecret activation/session locator is retained, or how the Run intent is consumed; on lost start/advance response and remount, use read-only authoritative recovery for the known session or show bounded unknown/stopped state without creating a session. Do not restore unknown send rights or introduce a second confirmation. Preserve legacy autorun/run-again semantics in their separate branch; normal deliberate subsequent Run remains available only after the prior guided activation is safely accounted/terminal. This can be designed locally without provider facts or adding008 full reconnect presentation.
requiredOracles: Render actual ChecksStudioPage at an autorun URL, allow one guided session/command, remount/reload the same URL and assert no second start/advance/effect. Repeat after completed run and after lost start/advance ACK.
Drive central-client401/login callback and remount with cached page intent; regain authority and verify read-only recovery or bounded unknown state, never automatic new guided Run.

React StrictMode/repeated runRequest/rerender/test switch/unmount issue at most one activation and cancel; a later deliberate Run uses a genuinely new activation, and existing legacy autorun regression still passes.

refs.symbolOrSection: §4.2 PendingCommand1/CommandStatus1 describe one SETUP or ACTION
GET/{id} and GET/{id}/result already expose authoritative lifecycle/publication projection
ordinary beginRun owns execution subscription/terminal editor release

findings.finding: The proposed minimal transport/client lists capability/start/pending-command/advance/command-status/cancel, but no typed session/result read or unambiguous session-terminal projection. CommandStatus1.COMPLETED can mean SETUP completed or one ACTION completed;204 may mean planning/no command. Neither proves all steps/assertions completed, cancellation settled, publication state or evidence availability. Terminal CommandStatus1 wording does not define a distinct session-terminal predicate or explain failure/awaiting-clarification/auth transitions. Account CONNECTED is expressly authentication-only. Yet007 must stop polling/release its activation/editor lock and present completed-awaiting-publication truthfully without sending sessionId to the ordinary execution subscription.
findings.impact: An implementer can stop after setup/one action, keep a finished guided session Running until the hard deadline and mislabel it expired, release Stop/editor lock early, or display stale ordinary execution/video as current guided evidence. Deferring that terminal projection to008 recreates a mandatory client dependency despite the otherwise acyclic split.
findings.requiredAction: Add the minimal read-only authoritative lifecycle/result consumption to007 using existing GET guided-sessions/{id} and/or/{id}/result and their closed supported DTOs, or specify an equally explicit session-terminal projection in the proposed protocol. Name typed transport/client/page ownership, deadlines/no-store/no-retry/cancellation semantics, and exact state mapping. SETUP/ACTION completion remains command-local; session success plus publicationPENDING means run completed/steps not ready to repeat, not saved readiness/media. Distinguish awaiting auth/clarification from active effects and show a bounded honest pause when full008 presentation is not available. Keep008 full progress/clarification/reconnect presentation, automatic finalize and first-guided recording separate; no hidden finalize/effect is needed for this status read.
requiredOracles: Hold after SETUP COMPLETED and after one ACTION COMPLETED while session still PROPOSING or awaiting the next command; Run/editor latch must remain active and no complete/ready/video claim appears.

Serve real session SUCCEEDED with result publication PENDING/CONFLICT and unavailable evidence: show completed-not-ready, no extra execution/finalize/gateway call, no playable current guided video or stale ordinary green evidence.

Delay cancellation ACK/terminal state: keep truthful Stopping; on session CANCELLED/EXPIRED/FAILED/UNKNOWN_OUTCOME settle the correct distinct state once. Reconnect reads restore that same state without another start/advance.
Changed source/config/account makes capability/readiness stale: current Run halts and historical evidence is clearly historical; sessionId is never used as ordinary executionId.

sourceBackedAssessments.boundary: Actual Run entry and acyclic ownership
sourceBackedAssessments.assessment: Design-level direction is sound: existing page mounts one RunControl; it invokes useRunGate. Proposed server route selection is after save+reread and before legacyprepare at hookline452, with client/typedtransport exported through studioApi. New files are named and real rendered production-page transport/browser oracle is mandatory.007 owns callable capability/authority client;008 owns the subsequent full UX/first-guided-video/finalize layer. None is implemented by this document; root must reconcile FileList/tasks before Ready.

sourceBackedAssessments.boundary: One deliberate Run and automatic scope transport
sourceBackedAssessments.assessment: Server-declared guidedFirst/savedReplay/legacy plus authoritative start descriptor prevents inferring application/account from English or TestDto. Body contains server commandID/hash, not user proposal/selector/value/permissions. Live automaticBFF request after model/preparation can obtain current authority without extra normal-click confirmations. Existing synchronous inFlight latch must span the new guided activation; the existing3-second accepted fallback cannot stand in for a longer active guided session.

Separate branch beforeprepare is the right seam. Keep dirty-save/conflict behavior and compatible ordinary beginRun/subscription; no guided sessionID masquerades as executionID. Existing catch handles COMPILE_REQUIRED/RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE by recompiling/re-executing at hooklines469–488; new guided and observed savedReplay branches must return outside that legacy fallback. Source/account/config drift and unsupported build on saved observed replay need safe deliberate recovery, not legacy compile/model repair. Existing legacy branch alone retains its documented retry.

Scoped discovery is advisory, no-store and value-free. Availability is conjunction of current authorized account, supported guided mechanism/origins/entry profile and later ordinary replay. Unsupported replay choice cannot enable Run/sign-in;200 unavailable is distinct from503transport failure and401/403 leak no account enumeration. Changing account/environment invalidates old capability and server start locks/rechecks source/config; no mode/handle hidden in accountRef. Same-session handoff and Sign in securely remain conditional on actual provider/view/profile facts, with no point-selection claim.

Reuse same Axios singleton,withCredentials and per-call baseURL rewrite preserves configured host/prefix. Reject ambiguous base rather than mutate global config or concatenate v1/v3. __doNotRetry on GET and no automatic POSTretry support ambiguous-send status-only policy. Existing IdempotencyFilter only covers api/v1 and api/v2, notapi/v3, so the proposed authority-scoped key is not presently blocked by its UUID rule; v3 service idempotency must still be tested. Proposed MSW mirrors belong to007 reserved handlers, while existing v1execute/cancel fixtures remain intact.

New guided rendering must map declared safe fixed codes/messageKeys, never reuse raw exception/message or legacy serverMessage slots. Centralclient logs response/error bodies before transport validation and normalizes raw server error fields; server facade must emit only closed value-free projections/data-free errors and wire tests must prove absence of provider diagnostics/handles/cookies. identityHash in public protocol is correlation, never UI prose/authority. No new password field,provider URL,credential lookup or unsupported sign-in view.

ExistingMUI Button,disabled reason with aria-describedby,spinner labels,role=alert androle=status are reusable. New account choice needs an explicit accessible label,safe configured display names and visible reason for unavailable/expired/loading/error states; keyboard Run/Stop and active editor/account locks must stay reachable. Status text must distinguish preparing/waiting/acting/stopping/unknown; never signal connected or completed from a spinner/redirect/commandlocal state. Full responsive three-panel/clarification/video polish stays008. No rendering/a11y test was run by this review.

Correctly keeps007 minimal status separate from008 automatic finalize,first-guided capture/upload/timeline and full human-facing reconnect/clarification presentation. A replay or MSW video cannot prove initial guided recording; textual redaction never guarantees video confidentiality. FindingUX007R102 supplies the missing minimum authoritative completion read without expanding that scope.

Use fixed safe narrative mapping for new guided errors/statuses; never render raw normalized exception/serverMessage,internalpermission/hash/provider URLs/handles/auth bytes. Test console/wire data where actual producer could emit private material; closed local/mock data alone cannot certify real provider secrecy.

Visible disabled reason viaaria-describedby;busy status via live role/status;Stop remains reachable while active/preparing, Stopping truthful until terminal,editor locked until actual session settles,read-only historical evidence cannot masquerade as current video/readiness.
